caption: The drawing features a rectangular quilt pattern, predominantly colored with shades of orange and light gray. The main design consists of a repeating basket motif, where each basket is composed of a triangular base with a semicircular handle on top, all shaded in orange. The baskets are arranged within diamond-shaped frames formed by orange lines, set against a light gray background. The quilt is bordered by two parallel orange lines creating a rectangular frame around the design. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the name "Helen McCollum" is written below the design in pencil.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
